messages:
Priya Menon: Heads-up — we have an evening onsite candidate arriving next Tue (May 14). Candidate prefers a quieter room and might need a loaner laptop. Can facilities/cafe/security help with a smooth check-in? :wave:

Sam Patel: Thanks Priya. Candidate name + phone? ETA? any travel stipend?

Priya Menon: Name: Jordan Kim, phone: +1-415-555-0192, ETA 6:15pm, arriving via Lyft. Company covers $40 transit — will send stipend via expense link. Jordan noted noise sensitivity and prefers low-light/quiet.

Taylor Ng: @Priya Menon got it. Reserving Quiet Room B on 5th floor 6–8:30pm. Will put a “Do not disturb — interview in progress” sign. Laptop loaner: do we need mac or linux VM?

Priya Menon: Mac is fine (M1). Also need HDMI & single USB-C adapter. Could Facilities drop off charger + adapter at the room?

Facilities Bot: Quiet Room B reserved (5th floor) from 17:45–20:45. Charger + USB-C adapter will be placed in room by 17:55. AV kit: HDMI cable + adapter in the basket.

Security Desk: Visitor badge ready under "Jordan Kim". Please ask candidate to present ID at desk; badge pickup on arrival. Parking note: visitor spaces on P2 limited after 6pm — recommend rideshare. Door access code for 5th floor lobby will be issued at check-in.

Sam Patel: Can someone paste the run-of-day so I can add to the calendar invite? I’ll DM the candidate the Zoom fallback link too (in case Lyft delays).

Priya Menon: Run-of-day (short):
```
18:15 — Candidate arrival / badge check-in (Security Desk)
18:30 — Meet & greet (10m) with Sam
18:40 — Panel interviews (3x40m, 10m between)
19:50 — Wrap + Qs (10m)
20:00 — Candidate leaves / debrief notes
```
Fallback Zoom: https://zoom.redwood-inc/room-fallback (use if candidate delayed or prefers remote)

Taylor Ng: I'll pin the sign and check AV at 17:50. Facilities will also wipe loaner mac in the room and set it on guest network.

Priya Menon: Perfect — @Security Desk please text me if badge pickup has any hiccups. Sam, I’ll send candidate contact + travel stipend link in DM. Thanks all :pray:
